bullets.text: Companywide CR was 100.4 (YTD 99.7); Personal Lines CR was 99.5 (YTD 99.1), missing the enterprise calendar-year 96 goal; Commercial Lines CR was 96.4; Property CR was 133.2 (YTD 119.6).

Prior accident year reserves negatively impacted quarterly CR by 3.4 points; personal auto severity rose about 12%, frequency increased about 1%; supplemental payments rose dramatically, reflecting inflation and longer repair times.
19 catastrophe events added 7.1 CR pts companywide; Property cats contributed 66.7 loss ratio pts; June 1 private reinsurance renewed $2.0B coverage excess of $200M retention with 100% placed.

Personal auto rates increased about 7% in Q2 (~11% YTD); commercial auto (non-TNC) rates rose 7% through June; Property rates increased 4% (~19% trailing four quarters); prioritized auto bundles and lower-risk properties.
Companywide NPW increased 18%; Personal Lines NPW grew 22%, reflecting rate increases and new applications; Property NPW grew 17%; Commercial Lines NPW rose 2%, or 6% excluding the TNC business.

Companywide PIFs grew 12%; Personal Lines PIFs rose 13%; Property PIFs reached nearly 3 million (+5%); commercial auto retention was negatively impacted by rate and underwriting actions, trucking market conditions, and economic weakening.

Pulling back media spend had about a 2 point favorable impact on Personal Lines CR; other margin measures included slowing new business through verification activities and bill plan offerings, alongside continuing operational expense discipline.

Issued $500 million senior debt; no bonds mature until 2027; debt-to-total capital stayed below the 30% guideline; investment portfolio returned 0.03% (fixed income -0.4%, equities 9.0%), maintaining a conservative posture toward cash and Treasuries.

BOP launched in 3 states (now in 41); heavy truck roadside assistance reached 46 states (~90% of eligible vehicles); commercial auto policy administration system modernization substantially completed.
Progressive achieved #2 writer status in private passenger auto, advancing toward its vision to become the #1 destination for consumers, agents, and business owners' insurance and financial needs.
